import re, urllib.request, sys

urls = [
    'https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Donald_Trump_and_Mike_Johnson_(March_9,_2026).jpg',
    'https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Donald_Trump_meets_with_Venezuelan_opposition_leader_Maria_Corina_Machado_in_the_White_House_Oval_Office_on_January_15,_2026.jpg'
]

for url in urls:
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
        html = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15).read().decode()
        # Find the full-size image link
        match = re.search(r'href=\"(//upload\.wikimedia\.org/wikipedia/commons/[^\"]+\.jpg)\"', html)
        if match:
            direct = 'https:' + match.group(1)
            print(f'URL: {url}')
            print(f'IMAGE: {direct}')
            print()
        else:
            # Try another pattern
            match2 = re.search(r'<img[^>]+src=\"(//upload\.wikimedia\.org/wikipedia/commons/[^\"]+\.jpg)\"', html)
            if match2:
                direct = 'https:' + match2.group(1)
                print(f'URL: {url}')
                print(f'IMAGE: {direct}')
                print()
            else:
                # Try to find any upload.wikimedia link
                match3 = re.search(r'(upload\.wikimedia\.org[^\"\\s]+\.jpg)', html)
                if match3:
                    direct = 'https://' + match3.group(1)
                    print(f'URL: {url}')
                    print(f'IMAGE: {direct}')
                    print()
                else:
                    print(f'URL: {url}')
                    print('No image found in HTML')
                    print()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Error for {url}: {e}')
        print()
"
